What do you think about these eco-friendly activities? Use expressions to support
or not support your partner’s opinion. You and your partner have two minutes.
| Avoid using plastic bags. Don’t purchase a new cell phone every year. |
| Buy energy saving lightbulbs. Take your own bags to a store.
B: That's a good point. Recycle it. For example, give it to a friend to use.
Make a list of community improvement ideas. How many can you remember?
Who are two people that both you and your partner think are role models?

What is a problem in your community? Go online and find information about one
of these problems, or choose your own idea. Find out about possible solutions.

for people to throw things away in. Trash cans need to be put on
